meta.name: Gen Z AI Style
meta.description: Machine-readable Gen Z vocabulary for AI agent integration

usage.format: Use this JSON for programmatic integration. Each term has: term, meaning, category, intensity (1-5), and optional example.

categories.core: Must-know slang (no cap, bussin, mid, etc.)
categories.agreement: Ways to agree/disagree (bet, say less, cap, etc.)
categories.reactions: Expressions and reactions (dead, shook, sending me, etc.)
categories.money: Money and business slang (bag, bread, guap, etc.)
categories.tech: Developer and tech terms (ship, deploy, refactor, etc.)
categories.gaming: Gaming-derived terms (gg, meta, OP, carry, etc.)
categories.social: Social and relationship slang (rizz, simp, ghost, etc.)
categories.lifestyle: Daily life terms (bed rot, glow-up, vibes, etc.)
categories.descriptors: Adjectives and descriptors (snatched, slaps, fire, etc.)
categories.parental: Terms parents should know (from gabb.com source)
